name: fluid-flow
description: Fluid-flow boundary conditions control pore pressure, fluid flux, leakage, head, and well source/sink terms in coupled or flow-only analyses.

keywords.name: pore-pressure-maximum
keywords.group: limited / combined pressure conditions (face apply, live-verified both engines)

keywords.name: pore-pressure-saturation
keywords.group: limited / combined pressure conditions (face apply, live-verified both engines)

keywords.name: head-saturation
keywords.group: limited / combined pressure conditions (face apply, live-verified both engines)

notes: Fixed pore pressure permits fluid exchange with the exterior.
Free pore pressure is the default impermeable condition for gridpoints.

'pore-pressure-maximum <f>' is a seepage-type limited-pp boundary: face pp stays FREE below f and is drain-clamped at f when flow would exceed it; bare form = f 0 (zero-pressure seepage face). State-verified against FLAC3D 9.7; absent from the official 9.x HTML docs.

'pore-pressure-saturation <v2>' applies pore pressure and saturation together; 'head-saturation <f>' is the head-based companion (needs fluid density + gravity set first). Both absent from the official 9.x HTML docs.
See the zone face apply command doc for the full verified keyword entries.
All three keywords also enumerate in live FLAC2D 9 (2026-08-13) — they are engine-family-wide 9.x features, not FLAC3D-only.
Use face discharge/leakage for boundary fluxes via 'zone face apply'.
'well' is a gridpoint-fix keyword — NOT a 'zone face apply' keyword. Use 'zone gridpoint fix well ...' for source/sink style flow.

examples.command:
model configure fluid
zone face apply pore-pressure 0 range group 'drain'
zone gridpoint free pore-pressure range group 'sealed'
